_comment: Reviewed explanations of each divergence the generator finds between docs/product/data-dictionary.md and the live schema. Keys are table|field|kind exactly as the generator computes them. With --strict, the generator fails on a divergence that is not informational and has no entry here, on an entry whose divergence no longer exists, and on a policy note naming a policy that does not exist. Status: 'explained' (an ADR records it), 'stricter than the dictionary' (the schema enforces more), 'not built (milestone N)', or 'founder ruling needed'.

rule_record|record_type|enumeration diff.text: denial_category is a sixteenth record type because the rules reference keeps the denial classification 'as a rule record'. ADR 0008 says this departs from the dictionary's fifteen and is raised with the founder; its revisit condition waits on that ruling. Approving this document approves the sixteenth type and amends the dictionary.

priced_line|expected_unrounded|retyped.text: numeric with no scale keeps the exact unrounded value; numeric(18,6) would round it (ADR 0029: golden line G09 carries more than six decimal places). CLAUDE.md rule 2 keeps the unrounded value beside the rounded one.

line_status|reason|encryption.text: A person's free text can name a patient, so it is encrypted with the practice data key; ENCRYPTED_COLUMNS in packages/db/src/crypto/cipher.ts lists it and the catalog test requires its enc:v1 CHECK.

case_line|written_off_text|encryption.text: The write-off's free text, beside the closed written_off_reason code the dictionary lists.

case_line|reopen_reason|encryption.text: The reopen reason is a person's free text.

packet_version|narrative|encryption.text: The narrative is the person's words, encrypted with the practice key; identifiers stay placeholders until export.

submission|reference|encryption.text: The payer's reference (a portal confirmation, a fax receipt) is free text a person types.

payer_response|notes|encryption.text: Notes on a payer response are a person's free text.

ledger_entry|reason|encryption.text: A ledger correction's reason is the person's words, encrypted; the amount, stage and evidence stay plain.

model_call|actor|renamed.text: The dictionary's single actor field is two columns: actor_kind (user, service or evaluation) and actor_id (null only for a synthetic evaluation call), with CHECKs model_call_actor and model_call_evaluation_is_synthetic.

model_call|updated_at|convention.text: A model call is written once (model_call_rules: 'a model call never changes; only the reviewer's decision is recorded, once'); reviewed_at records that one later change.

eval_example|updated_at|convention.text: An evaluation example is never changed or deleted (eval_example_rules).

audit_event|updated_at|convention.text: audit_event is append-only (audit_event_append_only, audit_event_no_truncate). The dictionary's own row gives `at` as its time, which the schema has.

usage_snapshot|updated_at|convention.text: A usage snapshot never changes (usage_snapshot_kept: 'a usage snapshot never changes').

job||missing table.by: ADR 0004; ADR 0049; README (pg-boss connects as its own login in the role tp_queue, which owns the pgboss schema)
job||missing table.text: The queue is pg-boss's own tables, which pg-boss installs in its own schema pgboss on start, owned by tp_queue, outside schema public and outside this document. The product's record of each job is job_run (singleton key, practice_id, idempotency key, attempts, outcome).

job_run||classification.text: The dictionary files job_run under 'Operations (no PHI by design)', and it holds no PHI column. Because it carries practice_id NOT NULL, the catalog rule requires a registry row, FORCE RLS and the tenant policy, so a practice's job history is tenant-scoped like its data.

notification||classification.by: ADR 0039 (Counts and totals only, in the schema)
notification||classification.text: The dictionary lists notification with user_id only. The schema adds practice_id NOT NULL and subject_id, so it is registered and tenant-scoped; its figures columns admit only integer counts and integer-cent totals (figures_are_counts, figures_are_cents), so no PHI can be written to it.

digest||classification.by: ADR 0039 (Counts and totals only, in the schema)
digest||classification.text: digest has practice_id in the dictionary too; with practice_id NOT NULL the catalog rule registers it. Counts and totals only.

legal_hold||missing table.text: Lifecycle tables for export and deletion are milestone 12 work, not started; /p/[practiceId]/settings/data shows placeholders. Kept in milestone 12 by CO-08.

export_job||missing table.text: As legal_hold. Not to be confused with the job type 'export' in job_run.

claim|index (practice_id, payer_claim_co.text: payer_claim_control_number is encrypted, so the index is claim_by_payer_claim_control_number on (practice_id, payer_claim_control_number_hash), the deterministic hash the dictionary's own note asks for.

policies.text: Members read their own organizations. Platform administrators also read every one, create group and firm organizations and edit them (the console). The billing role tp_billing reads every row and sets billing_customer_ref only while it is null.

'By grant or ownership' is implemented as the registered tenant policy on app.practice_ids, which the handler sets from the person's memberships intersected with grants in force (effective_practice_access). Platform administrators create practices; only the practice's administrators update it (restrictive).
Self and administrators, as the dictionary says; administrators may only create an invited user without MFA.
Adds a person's read of their own memberships and platform administrators. An organization administrator may not add a person already known to another organization (user_known_elsewhere).
Practice administrators approve and revoke; the practice's administrators and the grantee read. No route or screen yet approves or revokes a grant (CO-08).

Parties to it read it, as the dictionary says; platform administrators also read and record agreements. An e-signed agreement is recorded only through record_esigned_agreement(), executable by tp_esign alone (migration 20261101100000).

Platform administrators create one; members of the practice's own group and platform administrators read it; the application never updates one. ADR 0028 extends support grants to contract specialists and ADR 0038 to reimbursement reviewers (read-only); PRD 3 names support engineers only.

plan.subject: Remittance duplicate key
plan.where: PRD 8 (PRD.md:318); PRD 10 step 8 (PRD.md:428); CLAUDE.md Conventions; Data dictionary
plan.says: PRD 8: unique on (practice, sender, ISA13, TRN02). PRD 10 and CLAUDE.md: (practice, payee, ISA13, TRN02, BPR02). Data dictionary: unique (practice_id, sender_id, isa13, trn02, bpr02_cents).
plan.schema: remittance_once UNIQUE (practice_id, sender_id, isa13, trn02, bpr02_cents), the dictionary's key; ADR 0031 also treats a resend under a new ISA13 with the same payee, TRN02, TRN03, BPR02 and BPR16 as a duplicate.
plan.status: founder ruling needed (reconciliation-001, decision D2): confirm the dictionary's key; PRD.md and the dictionary stay verbatim as the imported plan, and CLAUDE.md's idempotency line is corrected to the key and ADR 0031's resend rule

plan.subject: CO-12 names tables that do not exist
plan.says: practice_settings gains two columns; packet_export records five parts.
plan.schema: Settings are practice.settings jsonb (the dictionary's own practice row), guarded by CHECKs and practice_setting_keys(). No packet_export table exists: an export is five columns on packet_version (export_pdf_key, export_csv_key, export_sha256, export_csv_sha256, exported_at).
plan.status: proposed (reconciliation-001, decisions D26 and D29): two keys in practice.settings; a new packet_export table with its parts

plan.subject: CO-12 'roles enum' and 'enum' columns
plan.says: Add financial_reviewer and auditor to the roles enum; readiness_grade and deadline_verification_status as enums.
plan.schema: There are no PostgreSQL enum types. Roles are text with CHECK membership_role_check and role_permission_role_check (10 roles); every enumeration is a CHECK.
plan.status: proposed: each CO-12 enum built as text with a CHECK, as every enumeration here is

plan.subject: CO-12 case_transition_log has no practice_id
plan.says: CO-12: case_id, from_state, to_state, actor_id, allowed, reason, at. CLAUDE.md: every table that can hold PHI has practice_id and FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY.
plan.status: proposed (reconciliation-001, decision D25): practice_id, a registry row, FORCE RLS; reason a closed code

plan.subject: CO-12 screening tables 'outside the RLS catalog'
plan.where: Change Order 001, CO-04 and CO-12; packages/db/src/catalog.ts
plan.says: CO-04: no practice_id, outside the RLS catalog. The catalog test: a table without RLS is global and the application role may only read it.
plan.schema: Not built. prospect_request is the precedent: no practice_id, RLS forced, written only through a SECURITY DEFINER function.
plan.status: proposed (reconciliation-001, decision D18): built as prospect_request is, so the catalog test does not change
